label: End-of-episode GO, committed a2 after a reward
explanation: Fires only at GO steps in the last ~10 trials of an episode (essentially all mass in ep_trial 90-99, none before 80), only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1 in 99.9% of activations) and the agent strongly prefers a2 (model_act==2 always; choice logit < -4.4 always). It never fires at D1 or D2, never on a1 choices, and almost never after no reward. Model value is low (<5.2) on every activation, which matches the late-episode decline in value. Within a window the activation climbs over consecutive rewarded a2 GO steps late in the episode (e.g. 0.3 -> 0.8 -> 0.96 -> 1.0), so its magnitude seems to track how late in the episode it is and the run of rewarded a2 choices. 95% of the mass is in episodes that started with S1 good (by the end, S2 is good in those). The recorded predicate uses only observed or computed quantities: time in the episode, the previous reward, and the policy logit. False positives are mostly earlier GO steps (ep_trial 90-94) and the first GO steps of a rewarded-a2 run, where the ramp has not yet started. A hard threshold cannot capture that graded build-up, so dev F1 is only about 0.67.
